question:
**Direction: Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option /no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.**

(**Most time**) they didn't have enough to eat and went to bed hungry
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Many a time."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason** "Many a time"** is the correct substitution is that it provides a more idiomatic and grammatically appropriate expression to convey the idea of frequency.
 
• **"Many a time"** is a common phrase used to indicate occurrences or instances.
 
• It fits well in the context of the sentence, conveying the message that there were repeated instances when they didn't have enough to eat and went to bed hungry.
 
• The other options either do not provide a suitable substitution or introduce grammatical errors.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

Correct sentence*: **Many a time**__ they didn't have enough to eat and went to bed hungry.*
